description: This file defines various constant classes for the Healthcare Connect frontend application, including API endpoint paths, storage key names, date formats, and general app constants.

classes.name: ApiEndpoints
classes.description: Contains static constants and helper methods for API endpoint URLs related to authentication, patients, doctors, consultations, and medical records.

classes.name: StorageKeys
classes.description: Defines keys used for storing authentication token, user ID, and user role locally.

classes.name: DateFormats
classes.description: Holds predefined date format objects for display, date-time display, and API communication.

classes.name: AppConstants
classes.description: Stores miscellaneous application-wide constants such as app name and network timeout.

methods.name: patientById
methods.description: Builds the endpoint URL for fetching a patient by ID.

methods.name: doctorById
methods.description: Builds the endpoint URL for fetching a doctor by ID.

methods.name: consultationById
methods.description: Builds the endpoint URL for fetching a consultation by ID.

methods.name: medicalRecordById
methods.description: Builds the endpoint URL for fetching a medical record by ID.
